Eleven Killed in Civilian Aircraft Crash in Northeastern France

A civilian aircraft carrying skydivers crashed in Tomblaine, northeastern France, resulting in the deaths of all 11 people on board, including the pilot. Local officials confirmed the incident. The aircraft reportedly shattered into pieces. Rescue operations were underway following the crash.
